card.title: Sing for the Sea - Little Wild Ocean Friends

metadata.author: Claudia Robin Gunn
metadata.description:
Calling all mermaids and pirates - dive in and sing with all your ocean friends.  

24 original tunes by award winning composer Claudia Robin Gunn to learn and dream with. There are sea shanties and sweet lullabies, ballads, and chill beats in this lilting collection. 

Ferries and tugboats, glow-in-the-dark sea life, marine conservation, undersea sponge cities and the true story of Inky the escaping octopus among many more.
